title: Improve dedicated autoscaler burst controls and utilization reporting
author: Maya Kapoor
description: This PR improves dedicated fleet autoscaler burst controls and the associated utilization reporting surface. Motivation: customer fleets observed large token-burst events that caused brief QoS regressions and left operators without clear visibility into burst credit consumption. Changes include: 1) smoother token-bucket burst smoothing logic (configurable window), 2) tighter throughput guarantees integration with priority routing to prevent starvation during bursts, 3) new Prometheus metrics and labels for per-fleet and per-priority burst_tokens, burst_smoothing_window and reported_capacity, and 4) fixes to existing utilization aggregation that undercounted short-lived bursts. The change is backwards-compatible by default and gated behind feature flags for staged rollout. Checklist: - implement tokenbucket smoothing and smoothing window config; - expose new metrics (dedicated_autoscaler_burst_tokens, dedicated_fleet_reported_capacity, dedicated_fleet_utilization_percent); - add unit and integration tests for burst scenarios; - update docs and changelog. Related: ENG-2145 tracks rollout strategy and dashboards; ENG-2210 tracks perf regression investigation.
